description.en: Original nominal3m representative karst spring rock-and-bed patch: a low real cavity beneath a thick continuous rock roof opens directly into a short exposed channel in the attached bed. Geometric cavity, wall thickness and bed connection remain visible without water or blue shading; no water, lights or flow simulation exported. Layout, crop and scale are artistic, not a measured spring, hydrological rate, named site or exact age.
description.zh: 原创名义3米岩溶泉口岩床裁片：厚实连续岩顶下低矮真实洞腔直接通向相接床面的短明渠。无水蓝色也可见洞腔壁厚及床面连接，不导出水灯或流动模拟。布局裁片与尺度属美术，非实测泉流地点年代。
